blocker.message: STORY-001-04: I updated TestRedBadArguments (main_red_test.go:82) to expect "usage: tally [--json] [--top N] <file>\n" and re-sealed it with main_top_red_test.go as b842a61. seal_red.mjs counted 8 tests against 3 scenarios, which trips the R-volume cap of 6. The count includes the 5 tests inherited from STORY-001-03's sealed main_red_test.go, because that file has to be in the seal list. The only ways under the cap are to delete or merge STORY-001-03's tests, or to fold my 3 top tests into one. I did not do either. The commit is valid and contains the corrected assertion. Orchestrator decision needed: either accept qa_red_lint as inherited-volume noise and proceed to Architect TPV, or authorize collapsing the three top scenarios into fewer tests. No re-seal count remains unused beyond one more.
